skill.summary: Track and analyze OpenClaw token usage across main, cron, and sub-agent sessions with category, client, model, and tool attribution. Use when the user asks where tokens are being spent, wants daily/weekly token reports, needs per-session drilldowns, or is planning token-cost optimizations and needs evidence from transcript data.
